_comment: SPDX ids a shipped dependency of Omni-Data-Bus (Apache-2.0) may use (OC-189, as capellactl's CAP-044). Copyleft licences such as GPL, LGPL and AGPL, SSPL, BUSL, and unknown licences, are not allowed. 'only' limits a licence to packages whose name starts with one of the prefixes. Changing this file needs the code owner's approval.
